title: 100-Rep Challenge
description: Five bodyweight moves. Twenty reps each. Go at your own pace.

title: Chest & Arms Push-Up Circuit
description: Three rounds with 45 seconds of rest between rounds.

title: Shoulders & Back
description: Three controlled rounds. Focus on posture and range of motion.

title: 5-Minute Mobility Flow
description: A quick reset for stiff joints. Breathe steadily throughout.

title: 90-Day Bodyweight Plan
description: Build consistency with a repeatable weekly structure. Start easy and progress gradually.
steps: Days 1–30: alternate full-body strength and mobility, 3 days per week
Days 31–60: add a fourth training day and one extra round
Days 61–90: increase reps or tempo while keeping recovery days
Rest at least one day between hard sessions
